CODE
2.3.5. 
Protected adults
A protected person who, pursuant to article 492/1 of the former Civil Code, has been declared incapable of choosing or modifying his matrimonial property regime may nevertheless do so after having, at his request, obtained the authorisation of the justice of the peace, on the basis of the draft drawn up by the notary.
In special cases, the Justice of the Peace may authorise the administrator to act alone, or authorise him or her to assist the protected person. A copy of the draft notarial deed is attached to the application.
